clinic.name: Silver Lake Dental
clinic.address: 580 5th Avenue NW Suite 100, New Brighton, Minnesota 55112

treatmentJourney.title: Warm Welcome & Records
treatmentJourney.description: Your journey begins in our thoughtfully designed, comfortable office where we gather your health history and utilize digital X-rays for a precise baseline of your oral health.

treatmentJourney.title: Comprehensive Clinical Exam
treatmentJourney.description: Dr. Snell or her associates perform a thorough evaluation of your teeth and gums, often using an intra-oral camera to show you exactly what we see in real-time.

treatmentJourney.title: Personalized Care Planning
treatmentJourney.description: We believe in clear communication; we discuss your diagnostic images and tailor a treatment plan that aligns with your specific goals for health and aesthetics.

treatmentJourney.title: Comfort-Focused Treatment
treatmentJourney.description: Whether receiving a filling or a crown, enjoy amenities like paraffin hand dips, noise-cancelling headphones, and nitrous oxide to ensure a pleasant experience.

treatmentJourney.title: Cosmetic Enhancements
treatmentJourney.description: For those looking to brighten their smile, we offer advanced cosmetic procedures including whitening and veneers to help you achieve a confident, radiant look.

treatmentJourney.title: Preventive Maintenance
treatmentJourney.description: Our hygiene team focuses on education and the vital link between oral health and overall well-being to keep your smile healthy throughout your lifetime.

doctor.name: Theresa Snell
doctor.bio: Dr. Theresa Snell is a dedicated leader at Silver Lake Dental who is passionate about cosmetic dentistry and helping patients achieve radiant smiles. She earned her Doctor of Dental Surgery from the University of Washington, where she also completed a Residency and Fellowship in Hospital Dentistry. Recognized as a Top Dentist by Minneapolis St. Paul Magazine multiple times, she is an active member of the ADA and Spear Study Club. Dr. Snell prioritizes a personal touch and genuine care for the New Brighton community.

reviews.name: David L.
reviews.text: The paraffin hand dip and noise-cancelling headphones made my visit feel more like a spa day than a dental appointment. Truly the most comfortable experience I've had.

reviews.name: Elena R.
reviews.text: I love the cutting-edge technology they use here. Seeing the high-res photos from the intra-oral camera helped me finally understand why I needed that specific treatment.

reviews.name: Mark T.
reviews.text: Dr. Snell and her team are so welcoming. They really take the time to explain everything clearly and the fresh baked cookies are a wonderful, friendly touch!
